_meta.sampling: Deterministic, no random(): ordering by md5(event_id::text). K_keyword: title ~* the broad disruption/cyber regex, max 4 per source, ordered by within-source md5 rank then md5, 40. L_routine: rank_score <= 33.3rd percentile of eligible (1.78), lowest md5, 25. Counts: {'H_rank': 30, 'K_keyword': 40, 'L_routine': 25, 'P_primary': 25, 'R_random': 40}
